name: io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield
title: HORIZON SHIELD — construction & renovation estimate auditor
description: Independent third-party auditor for Japanese construction & renovation estimates. Flags overcharge and returns tamper-evident, browser-recomputable fair-price receipts (SHA-256, PTKA/JIDEC). Also exposes an A2A agent card (get_agent_card) with a property-acquisition / renovation intake desk for agent workflows, and issues an AP2 fair-price attestation (create_ap2_fairness_attestation) that attaches to a Google Agent Payments Protocol Cart Mandate.
